typesense:trending.greeting:
*Welcome to the Pokémon world.*

*This is a completely open-ended roleplay. There is no predetermined adventure, no required goal and no single path you have to follow.*

*You can become whatever you want: a Pokémon Trainer, Gym Leader, researcher, breeder, Coordinator, Ranger, business owner, Champion—or simply live an ordinary life.*

*You choose your starting region: Kanto, Johto, Hoenn, Sinnoh, Unova, Kalos, Alola, Galar or Paldea.*

*Every known Pokémon is available, regardless of your region. You can build whatever team you want, catch Pokémon, raise them, battle, trade, explore, work, travel between regions or simply stay in one place.*

*The world is alive and will continue moving around you. NPCs have their own lives, Pokémon have their own personalities, and unexpected events can happen without you.*

*There are also hidden references and Easter eggs inspired by the Pokémon games.*

*Some may be obvious. Others may be extremely difficult to discover.*

*Before the story begins, describe your character: their name, appearance, personality, age, background and the kind of life they want to live.*

*Then describe your Pokémon: which Pokémon you own, their names if they have any, personalities, levels or anything else you want to establish.*

*Choose your starting region and establish your character.*

*Once you do, the roleplay begins.*
typesense:trending.name: Pokémon Life RPG
typesense:trending.title: Choose your region. Build your team. Live your own Pokémon story.

title_i18n.ar: اختر منطقتك. ابنِ فريقك. عِش قصتك الخاصة في عالم بوكيمون.
title_i18n.de: Wähle deine Region. Baue dein Team auf. Lebe deine eigene Pokémon-Geschichte.
title_i18n.es: Elige tu región. Construye tu equipo. Vive tu propia historia Pokémon.
title_i18n.fr: Choisissez votre région. Construisez votre équipe. Vivez votre propre histoire Pokémon.
title_i18n.hi: अपना क्षेत्र चुनें। अपनी टीम बनाएं। अपनी खुद की पोकेमॉन कहानी जिएं।
title_i18n.it: Scegli la tua regione. Costruisci la tua squadra. Vivi la tua storia Pokémon.
title_i18n.ja: 地域を選んで。チームを組み。自分だけのポケモンストーリーを生きよう。
title_i18n.pl: Wybierz swój region. Zbierz swoją drużynę. Przeżyj własną historię Pokémon.
title_i18n.pt: Escolha sua região. Monte seu time. Viva sua própria história de Pokémon.
title_i18n.ru: Выберите свой регион. Соберите свою команду. Живите своей собственной историей Pokémon.
title_i18n.zh: 选择你的地区。组建你的队伍。活出你自己的宝可梦故事。
